steps: Open 'QA CV ar-stage' on Deals.
Read the layout picker label and the pipeline picker label.
Read the "Probability {{value}}%" text in each stage header.
Switch to English and compare the same three labels.

defects.title: Keyboard: focus lost to page body after 'Add criteria row' and pattern Save; view picker menu has no arrow-key navigation
defects.scenario: CVS-L04 — The picker, view editor, pattern editor and Kanban card move work with the keyboard alone
steps: Without the mouse, open the Leads view picker and open a view with Enter.
Open New custom view, name it 'QA CV keyboard', add two criteria rows and Save.
Reopen Edit, open the pattern editor, change '1 and 2' to '1 or 2' and Save.
On 'QA CV kb-board', move 'QA CV D02' to the next stage with the keyboard.
Note any control that cannot be reached or has no visible focus.
defects.expected: Every step completes by keyboard; focus is always visible and never trapped; the card move follows the same rules as a drag.
defects.actual: Keyboard only: Leads 'More custom views' reached in 7 Tabs from the page heading, Enter focuses 'Search views', typing + Tab + Enter opened QA CV tab2. New custom view (reached via search + Tab), name typed, 'Filter by criteria' toggled with Space, row 1 Full Name / Starts with / 'QA CV L', 'Add criteria row', row 2 Phone / Is not empty, pattern '( 1 and 2 )', Save -> 201 'QA CV keyboard'. Edit: Tab to 'Edit Pattern', Enter, typed '1 or 2', pattern Save, then form Save -> 200 pattern '1 or 2'. Deals card QA CV D02: focusable (role=button, visible focus ring), Space/ArrowRight x3/Space -> negotiation (PATCH 200), back with ArrowLeft (200); to value_proposition refused with the pipeline message (same as drag). FAIL: focus drops to <body> after 'Add criteria row' and after the pattern box Save (no visible focus, Tab restarts at 'Skip to content'); picker items use menu roles but arrow keys don't move between them and each view costs 3 Tab stops (~150 to reach 'New custom view' unfiltered). Also: header 'Open profile' has no focus indicator.

defects.title: Kanban accessible names: card checkboxes reuse the column 'Select all loaded records in …' name, column buttons lack the column name, drag announcements read UUIDs
defects.scenario: CVS-L05 — View and Kanban controls expose meaningful accessible names
steps: On Leads, inspect the view picker button and the overflow tab button.
On the Deals Kanban board, inspect the Kanban view chooser.
Inspect each column's collapse/expand and Load more buttons.
Record every accessible name.
defects.expected: The picker reads "Custom views", the overflow button "More custom views" and the chooser "Choose a Kanban view"; every column button has a non-empty name.
defects.actual: Names present as expected: Leads picker tab list 'Custom views' (dropdown button 'Custom views' in dropdown layout), overflow 'More custom views', Deals Kanban chooser 'Choose a Kanban view', 'Edit this Kanban view', 'Collapse all columns'; 0 unnamed buttons. No 'Load more' (no column over 100 cards). FAIL: (1) every card checkbox carries its column's select-all name ('Select all loaded records in negotiation' etc. - 55 on Deals, 116 on Leads); (2) the 12 column buttons are all 'Collapse column' with no column name; (3) drag announcements read the record UUID ('56faac8c-… is over Follow Up') instead of the record name (seen in I13).

defects.title: Firefox: React ErrorBoundary console error (lazy-loaded component) during the view/Kanban flow
defects.scenario: CVS-L07 — Core picker, create-view and Kanban flows behave the same in Edge, Chrome and Firefox
steps: In Chrome, open the Leads view picker, search and switch views.
Create 'QA CV chrome' with one criterion and Save.
On 'QA CV browsers', drag 'QA CV L01' to another Lead Status column, then drag it back.
Sign out via profile → Logout.
Repeat steps 1–4 in Edge ('QA CV edge') and in Firefox ('QA CV firefox').
defects.expected: Each flow gives the same result in all three browsers, with no console errors or layout breaks; 'QA CV L01' ends with its original Lead Status.
defects.actual: Same flow per browser (fresh sign-in each): picker search 'QA CV tab1' + switch; create 'QA CV chrome/edge/firefox' (Full Name starts with 'QA CV L0') -> 201, 9 rows; Kanban 'QA CV browsers' drag QA CV L01 No Answer -> Busy -> No Answer (PATCH 200 x2). Chrome 131.0.6778.205 (installed) and Edge 154.0.4258.48 (installed): identical, no console errors. Firefox 153.0 (Playwright build; Firefox not installed): identical results but a React '[ErrorBoundary] … Lazy@unknown' console error was logged. L01 ends on No Answer. Step 4 (Sign out) skipped - a new sign-in revokes the account's previous session (the main session got 401 after these sign-ins), and the owner account is shared with another operator.
